classification: Derived POST HOC diagnosis of frozen observed native traces; outside canonical audit scope

method.scope: All252 saved requests checked for original inventory identity, strict saved candidate/delivered ranks and repetition stability; stage diagnosis uses first repetition only,72 positive query/arm/mode cases.
method.scoring: Every group remains OR over its authored alternatives, with one actual qualified-symbol excerpt covering the complete inclusive physical interval and matching its evidence SHA256. All groups are AND requirements. No credit is given for unioning fragments, a same-symbol partial window, an ID or an unreturned full window.
method.stages: Raw50 and rawtop8; all original canonical representatives and their first8 retrieval-only rows; canonical dependency-expanded eligible; actual arm full eligible, independently reconstructed character-only prefixes, actual token-packed prepostprocessor, actual postprocess proposal, chosen guard branch and final delivered source.
method.branch: A rejected shared-flow proposal is diagnosed through its exact coverage-reference branch. An accepted proposal is diagnosed through its own actual stages. Delivered partial windows take precedence over a simple eligible-omission label, because bounded backfill can later deliver a clipped prefix.
method.character_reconstruction: Replay only the recorded eligible order through the original12000-character physical-line prefix rule, without tokens, selectors, retrieval or models. Compare with actual prepostprocessor rows; backfill token-clipped IDs distinguish backfill clipping stages.
method.counts: Missing groups are occurrences per query/mode/arm, not independent queries. Candidate and controls share the same requests. Dataset has33 required groups across12 positives,8 multi-file positives,4 single-file controls and2 scoped absences.
method.limits: Descriptive posthoc attribution, not a repaired candidate, causal performance experiment, new qualification, benchmark tuning result or generalization claim. Frozen gates and outcomes remain unchanged.

next_bounded_experiment.scope: A separately frozen offline selection/window experiment on the now-observed corpus plus prior365 cases; no larger budgets, retrieval depth, model or automatic default change.
next_bounded_experiment.primary: Keep alternative raw windows associated with each canonical definition available to selection/packing instead of irreversibly choosing its first scored window. Test bounded per-definition window choices and query-specific cross-file allocation while preserving original delivered evidence.
next_bounded_experiment.basis: Four candidate missing-group occurrences have an exact covering raw window discarded by canonical representative selection;18 more survive canonical selection but do not reach final context. The same shared-caller protection does not address these rank/window choices.
next_bounded_experiment.bounded_checks: Freeze a generic label-free candidate and both controls, replay all observed inputs with zero individual group/complete/single-hit loss, and measure real packing cost. Inspect ordinary/backfill prefixes separately. Do not score a partial interval, pool OR alternatives across snippets, relabel ancestors or expand a source window for credit.
next_bounded_experiment.latency: Independently test a no-admission fast path that returns the existing control before a second reference packing; this is a proposed optimization, not a measured result here.
next_bounded_experiment.freshness: TanStack is now observed development data. Any next generalization claim requires another independently source-reviewed codebase after the new rule is fixed.
